description.simp_chinese: 可与政党协调、同时保留工作场所优先事项的社会主义工会联合组织。

description.english: The officer establishment holds coercive and institutional power disproportionate to its mass support.
description.simp_chinese: 军官建制掌握远超群众支持规模的强制与制度权力。

description.english: An inactive unification vehicle allows the 1939 bookmark to represent a later authoritarian party structure.
description.simp_chinese: 尚未活动的整合载体，使1939年剧本能够表现后来的威权政党结构。

description.english: A political agreement whose members retain their own interests and positions.
description.simp_chinese: 成员保留各自利益与立场的政治协议。

description.english: The presidential circle retains state access after the death of the Sanation movement’s founding leader.
description.simp_chinese: 在萨纳齐亚运动创始领袖去世后，总统派仍掌握国家渠道。

description.english: Military leaders command substantial institutional power and compete with civilian government circles.
description.simp_chinese: 军方领导人掌握显著制度权力，并与文职政府圈层竞争。

description.english: A nationalist opposition party combines social conservatism with an exclusionary national program.
description.simp_chinese: 将社会保守主义与排他民族纲领结合的民族主义反对党。

description.english: A democratic socialist opposition party remains separate from the communist underground.
description.simp_chinese: 区别于地下共产主义组织的民主社会主义反对党。

description.english: A peasant party represents rural participation and opposes concentration of power.
description.simp_chinese: 代表乡村政治参与、反对权力集中的农民政党。

description.english: A Christian democratic current differs from both the governing circles and radical nationalism.
description.simp_chinese: 区别于执政圈层与激进民族主义的基督教民主思潮。

description.english: A prohibited communist party organizes underground with limited institutional access.
description.simp_chinese: 遭查禁的共产主义政党，在有限制度渠道下从事地下组织活动。

description.english: Industrial and commercial associations influence policy through concentrated capital and state contracts.
description.simp_chinese: 工商协会通过集中资本与国家合同影响政策。

description.english: Independent labor organizations mobilize workers outside the state’s governing circles.
description.simp_chinese: 独立劳工组织在国家执政圈层以外动员劳动者。

description.english: A new government-supporting organization may begin activity and absorb part of the regime’s social base.
description.simp_chinese: 新的政府支持组织可开始活动，并吸收部分政权社会基础。

description.english: A political agreement whose members retain their own interests and positions.
description.simp_chinese: 成员保留各自利益与立场的政治协议。

description.simp_chinese: 依据国家原版政治兼容状态初始化的抽象执政组织。

description.english: An abstract reformist organization, without a claim to represent a named historical party.
description.simp_chinese: 抽象改革派组织，不宣称对应某个具体历史政党。

description.english: An abstract traditionalist organization allows multiple parties to share similar ideological positions.
description.simp_chinese: 抽象传统派组织，展示立场相近的多个政党可以并存。

description.english: Worker organizations have overlapping support with parties and their own bargaining interests.
description.simp_chinese: 劳动组织的支持者与政党重叠，并拥有独立协商利益。

description.english: A small popular constituency can hold substantial influence through economic institutions.
description.simp_chinese: 规模较小的群众支持基础可通过经济机构掌握显著影响力。

description.english: The military is represented as an institutional political actor rather than an ordinary electoral party.
description.simp_chinese: 军方被表现为制度性政治参与者，而非普通选举政党。

description.english: Clandestine workers seek room for independent organization. Repression reduces institutional access but cannot simply erase their social constituency.
description.simp_chinese: 地下劳工寻求独立组织空间。压制可削弱制度渠道，却无法直接消除其社会支持群体。

title.english: A petition to reconstitute the Centre

description.english: Former Centre organizers propose a legal organization. Acceptance creates an active political actor with a distinct program.
description.simp_chinese: 前中央党组织者提出建立合法组织。接受将产生具有独立纲领的活跃政治参与者。

label.english: Allow the Centre to resume activity

title.english: The National Government reviews its pact
title.simp_chinese: 国民政府审议合作协议

description.english: The smaller partners seek visible policy concessions. Their influence comes from coalition participation as well as votes.
description.simp_chinese: 小型执政伙伴要求明确的政策让步，其影响不仅来自选票，也来自联盟参与。

description.english: The Trades Union Congress asks for a formal consultation channel. It need not join the government to gain influence.
description.simp_chinese: 职工大会要求建立正式协商渠道。它不必加入政府，也能提高影响力。

label.english: Leave the existing arrangements in place

title.english: The Popular Front and the cabinet

description.english: An electoral agreement does not automatically determine cabinet membership. The parties must decide whether to support a common governing program.
description.simp_chinese: 选举协议不会自动决定内阁组成，各党仍须决定是否支持共同执政纲领。

label.english: Bring the electoral agreement into government
label.simp_chinese: 将选举协议转为执政合作

description.english: The veterans’ movement proposes a legal party organization. The new organization can enter competition without receiving a unique engine ideology slot.
description.simp_chinese: 退伍军人运动提出建立合法政党。新组织无需独占一个原版意识形态槽位，也能参与竞争。

title.english: Labor relations under the New Deal

description.english: Manufacturers and labor federations demand incompatible priorities. Both possess influence independent of their party connections.
description.simp_chinese: 制造商与劳工联合组织提出相互冲突的优先事项，双方都有独立于党派关系的影响力。

description.english: Reform-minded legislators seek a voice in the governing agreement. A broad party label does not erase their distinct priorities.
description.simp_chinese: 改革派议员要求在执政协议内拥有更大话语权，宽泛的党派标签并未消除其独立诉求。

description.english: Military and enterprise institutions seek room to act within the party-state. Concentrating authority may improve control while deepening discontent.
description.simp_chinese: 军方与企业机构寻求在党国体制内扩大行动空间。集权可强化控制，也可能加剧不满。

description.english: A broad rural constituency has little direct influence. The government can exchange concessions for greater institutional acceptance.
description.simp_chinese: 广泛的乡村支持群体缺乏直接影响力，政府可通过让步换取更多制度认同。

description.english: A hereditary institution and a mobilizing party need not prefer the same distribution of authority. The governing agreement requires maintenance.
description.simp_chinese: 世袭机构与动员型政党未必认同同一种权力分配方式，执政协议需要持续维护。

title.simp_chinese: 天主教社团与公共活动

description.english: Religious associations ask to retain autonomous social activity. Their support base overlaps with both monarchists and government supporters.
description.simp_chinese: 宗教社团要求保留自主社会活动，其支持者与君主派和政府支持者存在重叠。

description.english: Competing military factions seek influence over the state. Resolving the dispute changes political power without requiring either faction to become a party.
description.simp_chinese: 竞争性的军事派系寻求影响国家，解决争端会改变政治权力，而无需将任一派系变为政党。

description.english: Court, parties and military institutions disagree on who should participate in the governing agreement.
description.simp_chinese: 宫廷、政党与军事机构对谁应参与执政协议存在分歧。

label.english: Bring army leadership into the agreement
label.simp_chinese: 将陆军领导层纳入协议

description.english: A domestic settlement could grant rival networks legal room without merging their organizations or changing the state’s institutions.
description.simp_chinese: 国内和解可赋予竞争网络合法空间，而不必合并组织或改变国家制度。

description.english: A new civic political current asks for a recognized organization and a place in consultation.
description.simp_chinese: 新的公民政治思潮要求获得组织承认，并参与协商。

label.english: Permit the constitutional movement to organize

description.english: The Popular Front can become a governing agreement, but union and party participants will retain distinct interests.
description.simp_chinese: 人民阵线可以转为执政协议，但工会与政党成员仍将保留各自利益。

label.simp_chinese: 寻求更广泛共和中间派

description.english: The anarcho-syndicalist labor movement rejects absorption into parliamentary organizations. Dialogue may improve satisfaction without requiring coalition membership.
description.simp_chinese: 无政府工团主义劳工运动拒绝被议会组织吸收，对话可在不要求加入联盟的情况下提高满意度。

title.english: A Camp of National Unity begins activity
title.simp_chinese: 民族团结阵营开始活动

description.english: Government supporters propose a new political organization. Its emergence changes the governing compact without inventing a new ideology category.
description.simp_chinese: 政府支持者提出成立新的政治组织，该组织的出现将改变执政协议，而无需创造新的意识形态类别。

label.english: Authorize and support the new camp

description.english: Socialists, peasant representatives and Christian democrats seek greater political participation while preserving separate programs.
description.simp_chinese: 社会主义者、农民代表与基督教民主派在保留各自纲领的同时，寻求扩大政治参与。
